tldr: Morning batch (Sep 10): DeepSeek ships V4.1 Flash — a new-architecture multimodal model goes official around Sep 10 Beijing time, with all deepseek-v4-pro traffic served by V4.1 Flash at Flash pricing until V4.1 Pro ships (some Pro workloads >70% cheaper). Paul Christiano — RLHF pioneer, ARC founder, current NIST advisor — joins OpenAI's Foundation Board and Safety & Security Committee as a non-voting observer. Anthropic's own economics model puts Dario's bleakest job warnings in its extreme 2030 scenario (17.9% knowledge-worker unemployment), and Anthropic scientist Evan Hubinger puts >10% odds on AI ending humanity this decade. IBM's Granite time-series r2 tops permissive-license zero-shot forecasting; Suno launches v6 music models built with Warner, BMG and Believe; Mistral documents AI agents migrating 40,000 lines of Fortran 77. Kimi Work adds phone-based Remote Control; a new paper targets recursive self-improvement (NeoHorse-1); Qwen 3.8 mirrors GPT-5.5 Pro reasoning prefills; AWS and Qualcomm deepen their mutual AI-silicon dependence.
